requirements: The arm is already at saved Home; its position will be checked again before calibration.
Both disks must be visible from Home after the initial return.
The calibration plate is in its taught location and orientation.
The gripper is empty, the area is clear, and you are supervising the emergency stop.
Each step runs exactly as its button does in the classic view, including the controller preparation it does for itself.
The plate and holder match the accepted pickup setup.
Confirm the upward path, wrist sweep, crossing and lowering to Home are clear.
After gripping, the arm lifts 5 mm slowly and immediately returns Home with the claw unchanged.
One Yes authorizes this entire experiment, including automatic retrieval after its imaging job succeeds.
With the arm at Home, Squid will return to its saved loading position before delivery. The stage path and all pickup/return paths are clear, and the plate will be supported on release.
Imaging protocol: Live Squid XYZ stage with selected imaging settings (simulated camera).
Squid is in simulation mode: images are MOCK. Robot movement is REAL when you confirm.
Stay able to supervise the E-stop. Stop ends the workflow; a fault or uncertain result stops progression without a retry.

One confirmation covers all 25 cycles with this same plate and the same imaging settings. The next cycle starts only after the previous plate retrieval and Home return are verified. A fault, Stop or uncertain result ends the run without retry.
The Squid stage moves PHYSICALLY; only camera images are simulated. This verifies integration, not optical imaging.
Selected imaging: BF LED matrix full; 1 fields, 1 Z planes, 5 time points (5 images). Keep these selections unchanged until you confirm. The confirmed run uses this saved snapshot.
plan.summary: Calibrate and pick up the plate once. Run 25 complete cycles with the same plate: deliver to Squid, image, retrieve and return Home. One Yes starts all cycles; no confirmations between successful cycles.
